outputSections.label: Metaphor Conceptualization
outputSections.content:
Concept: technical debt
Cognitive Anchor: Understand how accumulative structural load shifts from designed elements to inadequate temporary workarounds.
Core Relationship: The relationship of structural dependency and weight distribution between temporary workarounds and canonical granite blocks.

outputSections.label: Cliché Risk Review
outputSections.content:
Selected Metaphor Family: decaying architectural foundations
Cliché Assessment:
Identified and rejected "cliche plant / gardening" due to high cliché exposure in this category.

Rejected Alternatives: cliche plant / gardening

outputSections.label: Visual Scene Proposition
outputSections.content:
Scene: Draw: A heavy granite block supported by a row of pillars where three pillars are replaced by temporary wooden sticks bowing under the weight.
Actors/Forces: Gravity pulling weight down on granite blocks.
Action: Granite blocks bowing the wooden sticks.
Consequence: An imminent threat of structural collapse if the sticks crack.
One Cognitive Action: Exposing the mechanical instability of temporary fixes.

outputSections.label: Composition & Staging Guides
outputSections.content:
Hierarchy: Primary focus: the bowing wooden sticks (center). Secondary focus: the heavy granite blocks (top). Foreground context: empty space.
Label Policy: Add single label 'STICK FIX' in minimal monospace font next to the wooden pillars.
Prohibited Symbols: none

outputSections.label: Validation Test & Risks
outputSections.content:
Validation Test: Show the illustration without text labels or titles. Ask: "What happens if the wooden stick breaks, and why is it there?" If they answer "The main stone block collapses because the stick was holding it", the cognitive action is successful.
Failure Risks: Risk that the illustrator adds a stylized character or decorative background, diverting from the singular relationship.
